mode.title: Prompt handling
mode.description: Redact offers Send, Edit, and Mask when credentials are detected. Block shows only Edit and Mask and prevents original sending.

protectClientIds.title: Protect named client IDs
protectClientIds.description: Also mask values assigned to client_id and client ID labels.

sensitiveNames.title: Additional sensitive field names
sensitiveNames.description: Up to 50 literal field names (2–64 letters, digits, spaces, underscores or hyphens). No secret values or regular expressions.
